mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) combined with diphenhydramine (anticholinergic antihistamine) increases anticholinergic effects and may cause hypertensive crisis through sympathomimetic potentiation.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, use alternative antihistamine with minimal anticholinergic properties and monitor blood pressure closely; allow 14-day washout after MAOI discontinuation.
